_doc: Standalone shared calibrator. Writes CalibrationEvent JSON to each consumer's inbox so grid and live see the same model_prob.
_delay_note: 0/0 = continuous loop, matches the previous in-process worker cadence.
_inbox_ttl_note: Sweep inbox files older than this so a stopped consumer doesn't cause unbounded growth.
_archive_note: On-chain Chainlink BTC/USD fallback (Polygon mainnet) for restart protection. Used ONLY when the WS buffer doesn't have a needed point - typically after calc downtime longer than the 180s buffer window. Set POLYGON_RPC_URLS env var to override (comma-separated). Empty list disables the fallback (degrades to WS-only).
_spot_provider_note: Current BTC spot uses Polymarket public RTDS Chainlink BTC/USD first. If RTDS is stale, falls back to a median of top-of-book WebSocket mids, then Binance REST as last resort. Barrier/PTB and settlement retrieval are unaffected.
